apps.description:
This is ScootRadar for Android, built without Google's libraries and signed with ScootRadar's own key. If your ScootRadar came from Google Play, or from GitHub or the ScootRadar beta F-Droid repository before 18 November 2026, uninstall it first: this copy is signed with a different key.

ScootRadar puts every shared e-scooter around you on one map, whoever runs it, so the closest ride is the first thing you see.

Each operator's app shows only its own fleet. ScootRadar shows them all, so the nearest scooter is simply the nearest one.

Know the walk: distance and walking time from where you stand, or from an address you look up. Directions draws the way on foot on the map and follows you as you walk.

Skip the flat ones: battery and remaining range, where the operator publishes them. Set a minimum and the map keeps only the scooters that reach it.

Price before you commit: an estimate from the operator's published rates for a ride of 5 to 30 minutes, with the free unlocks and free minutes of your passes taken into account. The operator's app shows the final price.

One tap to the right app: "Open in" takes you to the operator's own app, where you unlock and pay as usual. ScootRadar doesn't rent or reserve scooters.

The scooters of 39 operators, in more than 1,000 towns and cities in 59 countries. Where no operator publishes its data, the map says so and shows the closest cities that do.

No account and no ads. Your location is used on your phone to centre the map and work out walking times. When you browse, the server receives the visible map area. If you request walking directions, the app also sends your starting location and destination coordinates to the server. Anonymous usage statistics can be turned off in Settings.

Positions come from the operators and public authorities, and can be a few minutes old. ScootRadar is independent and not affiliated with the operators; their names are trademarks of their owners.
